notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Moved over to steam networking - old networking is gone.
[*] New version will now allow anyone to connect to anyone on steam.
[*] No more port-forwarding - it just works.
[*] Incompatible with old versions because of this change.
[*] Upgraded engine - should load + run better.
[*] Moved map editor into it's own launch option.
[*] Allow host to change FF vs TDM percentage chance for their lobby.
[*] --- BAD NEWS ---
[*] Had to remove IP connecting - but connecting through steam is better anyway.
[*] Because of the Networking overhaul some achievements may not be unlock-able - report them and I will try to fix them.
[/list]
